يستنجبون (form X)
# يَسْتَنْجِبُونَ (yastanjibūna) /jas.tan.d͡ʒi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# يُسْتَنْجَبُونَ (yustanjabūna) /jus.tan.d͡ʒa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
